name: Lilia
source:
Likes: Fishing, Meditation, Martial arts
Doesn’t like: Getting fish, Kinoko

A local girl, often found quietly fishing at the lakeside. Preferring silence over small-talk, Lilia rarely makes any effort to start a conversation. She pays attention to her surroundings nevertheless, and has a ranking for people, animals and other lifeforms she likes.

Lilia practices martial arts to keep her body in shape and reflexes sharp. She believes that a well delivered roundhouse kick can solve most if not all troubling situations.

    “Hmm… you are currently at rank 274, just below that nice snail over there.”

[From [url=https://arcusplume.com/twin-blue-moons/characters/lilia/]official website[/url]]
